checkpoints.description: [1/1] plan: cache the stdin handle and refill 64 KiB at a time so char_stream stops paying two syscalls per 4 KiB

impact_assessment.why: contract: emit_read_char caches the stdin handle in a new static writable (STDIN_HANDLE_LABEL, zero-initialized, fetched via GetStdHandle only when zero) and STDIN_BUFFER_SIZE moves 4096 -> 65536; dependency: win32 semantics - the stdin handle is stable for process lifetime, so caching cannot go stale; concurrency: single-threaded programs, no stdin races; state: runtime.py only, fast per-byte path byte-shape preserved, appended reserve keeps earlier labels' offsets
impact_assessment.benefits: contract: char_stream refills drop from 1024 to 64 ReadFile calls and from 1024 GetStdHandle calls to 1; dependency: other read_char users (interactive tests) share the fast path unchanged; concurrency: none; state: char_stream -8 to -30 percent if the gate delta is syscall-bound, others in noise
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a wrong cache guard would re-fetch or misuse an invalid pseudo-handle; dependency: zero-init writable cache with a test flag on every refill, invalid-handle path unchanged; concurrency: none; state: the ADR-058 lesson says layout shifts can regress the fast path - the helper's internal refill block grows, shifting the fast-path bytes
impact_assessment.mitigation: contract: guard on exactly cache == 0 before fetch, else reuse; dependency: failing-first fixup test asserts STDIN_HANDLE_LABEL referenced and GetStdHandle IAT load present once, plus an end-to-end stream over 70 KB so every refill boundary runs; concurrency: none; state: same-window char_stream A/B old vs new plus the full high-priority gate before commit, revert fast on any fast-path loss

checkpoints.description: [1/2] while-true back edge emits a bare jmp instead of movabs/test/jne; [2/2] read_char prologue loads cursor and count with mov_load_rip instead of lea_rip+mov_load

impact_assessment.why: char_stream pays ~14 instructions per byte: the caller back edge lowers the literal-true loop condition to movabs+test+jne (10 wasted bytes + 2 uops per byte), and read_char's prologue loads cursor/count via lea_rip+mov_load pairs (20 bytes) where direct rip loads are 12
impact_assessment.benefits: every while-true loop in every cairn program drops 2 dead uops on its back edge; read_char's hot fall-through prologue shrinks by 8 instructions-bytes, measurable on the 4M-iteration char_stream scoreboard case
impact_assessment.risks: contract: emitted code shape changes for while-true loops only - same semantics because the condition is the literal true; dependency: new consumer for the existing mov_load_rip helper only, no new machine helpers; concurrency: none - static single-threaded image; state: cursor/count slot layout unchanged, only their load encoding
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first shape tests for both lowering changes; same-window stash A/B on char_stream with output-identity check; full gate --save --compare plus quiet-window re-run rule; fast revert if A/B shows any regression

checkpoints.description: milestone 1 (while-true bare jmp) kept: A/B never regressed across 3 windows, best 12.32->12.01; milestone 2 (rip-direct read_char state) measured 1.22-1.42x slower over 4 windows and reverted; pinned by ReadCharPrologueTest; 1108 tests pass; gate exit 0 (windows load-noisy, A/B is the decision evidence); ends with checklists: passed
